## Salinity {#sec-sss}

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**No quantitative skill assessment for salinity in v1.0.**
Regionally, available satellite SSS products (SMOS, SMAP) are not of sufficient
quality in the Arabian Gulf — a shallow, hypersaline, marginal sea where the
algorithms degrade — to support a defensible skill comparison. The salinity
content here is therefore presented as model-derived characterisation only, not
as a skill claim.
:::
